name: tldraw-tag
description: Live audience tag on a tldraw canvas — Auth0 admin, Colyseus server, shrinking zone.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @inkt/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @inkt/shared && npm run build -w web
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @inkt/shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @inkt/shared && npm run test -w server
